name: bios
description: Your store's numbers, what waits for your yes, and your BIOS team, inside ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Your store's numbers and your BIOS team, in chat
interface.longDescription: BIOS runs an e-commerce company's AI team. Connect your BIOS account to read revenue, orders and ad spend from your store, see what your team is waiting for a yes on, and ask your team for work. BIOS never guesses a number: anything it cannot read from your store is marked unavailable. Nothing is sent to customers, published or changed in your store from chat: your team plans the work in BIOS, using the AI subscriptions connected there, and any send, publish or spend it proposes waits for your yes in the BIOS app.
defaultPrompt: Use BIOS to give me this week's business review
Use BIOS to show what is waiting for my yes
Use BIOS to ask my team to plan a campaign
